security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU TCG multi-hart SMP emulation, when Hart A stores new instructions to a memory region with cacheable/coherent PMAs and Hart B executes from that region, QEMU's Translation Block (TB) cache for Hart B is never invalidated unless Hart B (or Hart A via IPI) explicitly executes FENCE.I — but Ziccid requires stores to *eventually* become visible to all harts' instruction fetches without any FENCE.I execution, meaning stale TBs must be eventually purged by a mechanism other than FENCE.I trapping.
security_spec.summary: Ziccid mandates eventual instruction-fetch coherence across harts without FENCE.I; QEMU TCG's TB cache only invalidates on explicit FENCE.I or full tb_flush, so cross-hart JIT code stores may be executed as stale guest instructions indefinitely, violating the Ziccid 'eventually visible' guarantee
